comments.text: Line 3, `*KEY0`: the same f0 as N1's, `DELETE1,6`, `32220`, `32225`, `MODE7` and `RUN`, each ended by RETURN (|M), for the adventure part 2 to press once it has moved itself to &0E00 (its lines 5-6). The definition lives in the MOS's soft-key buffer at &0B00, which CHAIN does not touch.
Lines 20-60: MODE 7 and ON ERROR RUN; `*FX15,0` empties every input buffer; `*FX200,2` makes BREAK clear memory; VDU 6 and the cursor off; a pause of 0.8 seconds (INKEY(80)).

Line 70: K%=-3, the sound level the player gets by pressing the space bar straight away (level 1); part 2 keeps its level in K% where part 1 keeps it in S% (part 2's S% holds the spells). Then `FLOWERS OF CRYSTAL` in double height on rows 6 and 7, three passes through seven colour pairs (letters in colour a on a band in colour a-1, a from 7 to 1), as in N1 but with empty counts of 200 and 2000, twice N1's, so the colours change half as fast.
Line 75: `part  2` in double height, rows 9 and 10, and a pause of two seconds.

Lines 80-150: `Select sound level 0-5`, one key read (GOSUB 200), then `< S >` and `Press the space bar when you are happy with the sound level.`, and from then on GOSUB 200 for ever. Only the space bar, at line 210, leaves.

Lines 200-205: waits for a key until it is 0-5 or the space bar. A digit n sets K%=-3n, 0 (silent) to -15 (loudest), and plays two short notes at that loudness (pitches 150 and 134, channels 1 and 2), then returns.

Lines 210-218, the space bar: A%=0, `Please wait.`, auto-repeat off (`*FX11,0`); level 0 also turns the MOS's sound off (`*FX210,1`). `*LOAD` CODE2/1 (to &0900) and CODE2/2 (to &0C00). Line 218 defines envelopes 2 and 3, the only sounds part 2 makes besides envelope 1, with their attack and decay targets set from K% (-(K%*5)+40, 40 at level 0 to 115 at level 5): the level reaches part 2 through the envelopes, where part 1 gives S% to every SOUND.
